full_sentence: The negotiations finally concluded, the delegates signing the treaty at dawn.

options.text: to sign the treaty at dawn.
options.why_wrong: An infinitive has no subject of its own, so it cannot form the absolute phrase that the stem requires.

options.text: the delegates had signed the treaty at dawn.
options.why_wrong: A finite verb creates a second main clause with no link, so the sentence is not an absolute construction.

options.text: the delegates signing the treaty at dawn.
the delegates sign the treaty at dawn.
options.why_wrong: A finite present-tense verb cannot be attached to the sentence as an absolute phrase, so the structure is ungrammatical.

grammar_focus: Absolute clause: noun phrase plus participle, placed after the main clause
explanation: An absolute clause has its own subject and a participle, here 'the delegates signing', which describes what accompanied the conclusion of the negotiations.
translation: Переговори нарешті завершилися, а делегати підписували договір на світанку.
